name: Dolphin Cove Marina Gulf Shores, AL
description: Kayaking at Dolphin Cove Marina in Gulf Shores, AL, offers an unforgettable experience as you paddle through the tranquil waters and encounter a vibrant array of dolphins and sea life. The rich marine ecosystem is home to an abundance of fish, graceful sea turtles, and various coastal bird species, making every outing an adventure in wildlife observation. At Dolphin Cove Marina, we are dedicated to preserving the natural beauty and ecological health of Alabama's marine environment while providing exceptional experiences for our guests.
